item.title: Arashiyama Guide: Bamboo Grove, Temples & the Hozu River
item.description: On the western edge of Kyoto, where the city meets forested mountains and the Hozu River, lies Arashiyama — a district that packs a soaring bamboo grove, a UNESCO Zen garden, a monkey mountain, riverboats, a scenic railway, and a famous moon-crossing bridge into one beautiful, walkable area. The towering green corridor of the bamboo grove is the headline image, but Arashiyama rewards a full half-day or more of exploring.

item.title: Sagano Scenic Railway Guide: The Romantic Train Through the Gorge
item.description: The Sagano Romantic Train, known affectionately as the Torokko, is a nostalgic open-window sightseeing train that trundles along the cliffs of the Hozu River gorge between Arashiyama and Kameoka. For 25 slow, scenic minutes it follows the river through forested mountains that explode with colour in autumn, froth with cherry blossom in spring, and glow deep green in summer — a beloved Kyoto experience that pairs perfectly with a traditional boat ride back down the same gorge.
